targets.query:
from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "risk_score")
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "total")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "is_tracker")
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "trackers")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "pii_findings")
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "pii")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "offshore")
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "offshore")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "risk_score")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "requests")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "risk_score")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "avg_risk")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "is_tracker" and r._value == 1)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.owner != "none")
  |> group(columns: ["owner"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)
  |> yield(name: "top_owners")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests" and r._field == "risk_score")
  |> group(columns: ["risk_level"])
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "risk_distribution")

from(bucket: "live_requests")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "requests")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "page_domain", "domain", "owner", "category", "risk_level", "risk_score", "is_tracker", "offshore", "fingerprinting", "pii_findings"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> yield(name: "live_feed")
